reason: The 1.0 release scope now explicitly includes the complete ReefVision platform, including classification, active learning, Prompt Assist/providers, video tracking and behavior analysis, depth/RGB-D workflows, interoperability, and fusion workflows. Production development is reopened on feat/1.0-full-platform while release validation remains mandatory.
notes: The stabilization freeze is intentionally lifted for the full 1.0 implementation branch.
All major capabilities previously planned for later releases are now required for 1.0.
New production modules and migrations are allowed when they directly advance the 1.0 scope.
Release claims remain prohibited until backend, frontend, migration, scientific-validation, provider-acceptance, workflow, video, interoperability, packaging, and clean-machine gates pass.
The branch must preserve provenance, immutable dataset/version behavior, review-before-accept safety, and calibrated-science warnings while features are completed.
